statement: Steward-write role matrix (N-0086): every write on /imports (DSI/CST/shipment pipeline steps, steward resolve/ignore/bulk/resolution-plan, batch propose/jobs), /cst-steward, /mappings, /product-master-gaps (scan, preview, apply) and /exceptions (delete, clear-all) requires steward or admin via require_roles. Job create/process/cancel/retry on /imports require admin, steward or planner at the route and then a per-template check: planners only for cpor_historical_cases and cpor_payment_evidence (create, process) plus current_lineup, unified_lineup, bulk_lineup_backfill (cancel, retry); viewers never. Reads stay sign-in only. Web: Import Center, steward queue, CST steward, catalogue gaps and shipment evidence pages show an honest read-only notice and disable write controls for planner/viewer; the exceptions inbox hides delete/clear for them. Not changed here (deferred): customer/distributor master writes and listing-capture writes remain sign-in only. product-master-gaps /preview is read-only server-side but is gated with the write it precedes.
